page.content:
Original World Cup, retired when Brazil won it a third time.

How Jules Rimet Trophy connects

  • Character: Jules Rimet — The original World Cup trophy was named for Jules Rimet.
  • Item: FIFA World Cup Trophy — The Jules Rimet Trophy was retired before the current FIFA World Cup Trophy.
  • Faction: Brazil national team — Brazil retired the Jules Rimet Trophy with a third World Cup in 1970.

What is Jules Rimet Trophy?

The Jules Rimet Trophy was the prize from 1930 until 1970, when Brazil's third title retired it. The cup was later stolen in Rio and never recovered.

Key threads lead to Jules Rimet, FIFA World Cup Trophy and Brazil national team.
